spells.why: Entangling Roots holds enemies in place and every spec's rotation uses it.

Restoration.why: Healing Touch at rank 2 heals so well with healing power gear that some Restoration Druids heal dungeons with it alone.

Feral Combat.why: Healing Touch is in the Feral rotation as the last heal you use to top up between pulls, and this is its first trainer rank.

spells.name: Nature's Grasp
spells.why: Nature's Grasp roots an attacker so you can get away and heal.

Feral Combat.why: The Feral bear rotation uses Nature's Grasp to root attackers so you can get away and heal.
Demoralizing Roar is a bear rotation spell you keep on every enemy you tank to cut their damage.

Balance.why: Demoralizing Roar is a set step of the Spellbear rotation right after you shift into Bear Form.

Feral Combat.why: Enrage gives the bear the rage it needs, and bear tanking comes together once you have it and Swipe.

Balance.why: Enrage is a set step of the Spellbear rotation to get rage for more Swipes at the start of a pull.

spells.name: Regrowth
spells.why: Regrowth is a main Restoration heal and the other specs' rotations use it to heal themselves.

spells.name: Bash
spells.why: Bash is hard to use often because you must swap to bear and lack the rage at once.

Feral Combat.why: Swipe is the bear's attack for several enemies and the main damage of the recommended Spellbear leveling build.

Balance.why: Swipe is what the Spellbear rotation presses until every enemy in the pull is dead.

spells.name: Faerie Fire
spells.why: Faerie Fire lowers the target's armor and you keep it on bosses for the whole group.

Feral Combat.why: Faerie Fire is a fixed cat rotation step you keep on the target and use as a filler for Omen of Clarity procs.

Balance.why: Faerie Fire is a step of the Spellbear rotation to raise your damage on tough enemies.

spells.name: Hibernate
spells.why: Hibernate puts a beast or dragonkin to sleep for crowd control in dungeons.

Feral Combat.why: Maul is the bear's main single target rage spender and this is its first trainer rank.

spells.name: Omen of Clarity
spells.why: Omen of Clarity gives free casts and attacks that you spend on your biggest heal or attack.

Restoration.why: The Restoration rotation has you melee to trigger Omen of Clarity and spend each proc on a max rank heal.

Feral Combat.why: The Feral rotation spends every Omen of Clarity proc on Shred in cat or Primal Bite in bear.

Balance.why: Starfire is the big cast of the Balance hard casting rotation along with Wrath.

Feral Combat.why: Cat Form is a leveling power spike that turns Feral into a stealthy burst fighter.

Restoration.why: The Restoration rotation shifts to Cat Form between heals for better mana regeneration.

Feral Combat.why: Claw is one of the two cat attacks at level 20 and builds combo points when you cannot get behind the target.

spells.name: Prowl
spells.why: Prowl lets you sneak past enemies and pick your fights while leveling.

Feral Combat.why: Prowl starts the cat rotation, since you sneak behind the enemy before the opener.
Rip is the cat's main combo point finisher and the bleed you keep on longer fights.
Shred is the cat's main energy spender and combo point builder from behind.

spells.name: Healing Touch
spells.why: Healing Touch rank 4 is the most mana efficient heal once you learn it.

spells.name: Rebirth
spells.why: Rebirth brings a dead ally back in combat and needs a reagent you should carry.

Feral Combat.why: Ferocious Bite is the cat rotation's finisher at five combo points or when it will kill the enemy.
Rake is a bleed and combo point builder that does a lot of damage, so you apply it early on each target.

spells.name: Remove Curse
spells.why: Remove Curse clears curses from your group and you should use it every time.

spells.name: Dash
spells.why: Dash speeds up travel when you will run for its full duration.

spells.name: Abolish Poison
spells.why: Abolish Poison clears poisons from your group and you should use it every time.

spells.name: Claw
spells.why: Claw rank 2 is on the list of ranks to train at 28.

spells.name: Travel Form
spells.why: Travel Form is your fast way to move between quests until you have a mount.

spells.name: Mark of the Wild
spells.why: The level 30 Mark of the Wild rank is on the list of ranks to train.

Restoration.why: Tranquility is the Restoration rotation's step for a party wide emergency when a pull goes wrong.

spells.name: Ferocious Bite
spells.why: Ferocious Bite rank 2 is on the list of ranks to train at 40.

Feral Combat.why: Ravage is the cat rotation's opener from Prowl once you learn it.

spells.name: Claw
spells.why: Claw rank 3 is on the list of ranks to train at 38.

spells.name: Hurricane
spells.why: Hurricane is the Balance area damage spell that also slows enemy attacks.

Balance.why: Hurricane is the Balance rotation's spell against five or more targets.

spells.name: Ferocious Bite
spells.why: Ferocious Bite rank 3 is on the list of ranks to train at 48.

spells.name: Innervate
spells.why: Innervate restores mana fast and is on the list of spells to buy at 40.

spells.name: Mark of the Wild
spells.why: The level 40 Mark of the Wild rank is on the list of ranks to train.

spells.name: Barkskin
spells.why: Barkskin cuts damage taken and stops pushback, and it works even while stunned.

spells.name: Claw
spells.why: Claw rank 4 is on the list of ranks to train at 48.

spells.name: Ferocious Bite
spells.why: Ferocious Bite rank 4 is on the list of ranks to train at 56.

spells.name: Mark of the Wild
spells.why: The level 50 Mark of the Wild rank is on the list of ranks to train.

spells.name: Claw
spells.why: Claw rank 5 is on the list of ranks to train at 58.

spells.name: Mark of the Wild
spells.why: The level 60 Mark of the Wild rank is on the list of ranks to train.

talents.name: Moonglow
talents.why: Moonglow saves mana, and mana is what limits Balance while leveling.

talents.name: Feral Swiftness
talents.why: Feral Swiftness gives cat run speed and dodge in all forms, and it is one of the best early leveling talents.

talents.name: Nature's Splendor
talents.why: Nature's Splendor makes your damage and healing over time last longer, so you take it as soon as you can.

talents.name: Insect Swarm
talents.why: Insect Swarm is the strongest Balance spell for its cast time and joins the rotation after Moonfire.

talents.name: Swiftmend
talents.why: Swiftmend is an instant big heal that saves a player in danger and unlocks much of your healing.

talents.name: Eclipse
talents.why: Eclipse defines the rotation and is required for the hard casting Balance build.

talents.name: Improved Tranquility
talents.why: Improved Tranquility puts the group heal on a short cooldown and can save most dungeon wipes.

talents.name: Nature's Swiftness
talents.why: Nature's Swiftness makes a max rank Healing Touch instant for emergencies.

talents.name: Primal Bite
talents.why: Primal Bite is the bear's best button and its main rage spender, and tanking feels great once you have it.

talents.name: Shifting Power
talents.why: Shifting Power turns mana into energy for cat DPS and you use it on cooldown.
